senses.zh_definition: 西纳特拉：姓氏；在音乐语境中常指美国歌手、演员弗兰克·西纳特拉。
senses.en_definition: A surname; in musical contexts, often a reference to the American singer and actor Frank Sinatra.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga; dalam konteks muzik, sering merujuk kepada penyanyi dan pelakon Amerika Syarikat, Frank Sinatra.
senses.nuances: 属于 nama khas，规范写法首字母大写。缺少上下文，不能确认该数据项一定指 Frank Sinatra。词组示例适用于这一音乐指称，不代表经统计验证的高频搭配。生平依据 [Concord 艺人介绍](https://concord.com/artist/frank-sinatra/)；读音依据 [Cambridge 发音词条](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/sinatra)。马来文释义为编辑说明。

dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道；以 Frank Sinatra 为明确指称
dual_scenarios.ms: Program tersebut menampilkan persembahan lagu yang pernah dipopularkan oleh Frank Sinatra.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该节目安排了曾由弗兰克·西纳特拉唱红的歌曲演出。
dual_scenarios.en: The programme features performances of songs popularised by Frank Sinatra.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak dengar lagu Sinatra kat rumah je malam ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu mendengar lagu Sinatra di rumah sahaja malam ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 今晚我就想在家听听西纳特拉的歌。
dual_scenarios.en: I just want to stay home and listen to Sinatra tonight.
spoken_features: aku 适用于熟悉的同辈

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah dengar lagu Sinatra yang aku hantar tu?
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah mendengar lagu Sinatra yang saya hantar itu?
messages.zh: 我发给你的那首西纳特拉的歌，你听了吗？
messages.en: Have you listened to that Sinatra song I sent you?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, sedaplah. Nak dengar lagi kat rumah nanti.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, lagunya sedap didengar. Saya mahu mendengarnya lagi di rumah nanti.
messages.zh: 听了，好听。待会儿回家还想再听。
messages.en: Yeah, it's lovely. I'll listen to it again when I get home.

etymology.historical_story: The relevant story is cultural transmission rather than Malay word formation. Frank Sinatra worked across recordings, radio, concerts and film, so his surname can appear wherever his performances are discussed. It remains a personal name in a Malay sentence. The packet does not establish the surname's deeper linguistic origin or identify its intended bearer. See [Concord's artist biography](https://concord.com/artist/frank-sinatra/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Sinatra，联想歌手站在麦克风前演唱；它是人名，不要把开头 si 当作马来语称人标记来拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 专名本身没有敬语等级。正式介绍人物时先写 Frank Sinatra，再按语境使用姓氏。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 音乐讨论中可直接使用；其他语境应先确认所指人物或事物，不能仅凭姓氏推定身份。
